• Odisha’s 1st Twin Tunnel | Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor | Package-07 (OD-07)*
Experience the magnificent engineering of the *Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor (NH-130CD)* through stunning aerial drone footage of Package-07 in Koraput, Odisha.
This package features an impressive *3.42 km Twin Tunnel,* constructed through the challenging hilly terrain of the Eastern Ghats. The tunnel is one of the major engineering highlights of this ambitious greenfield highway project.
• Project Highlights:*
• Project: Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor
• National Highway: NH-130CD
